verdict.rationale: Source availability is a fair question for a managed database service, so the axis applies. The evidence only says ObsessionDB runs the official ClickHouse engine on a rebuilt storage layer. Nothing shows that ObsessionDB's own code, such as the storage layer, coordination layer or CHKit, is published under an open license. Upstream ClickHouse's openness is a different product's capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
